notes_for_editor: Single source (the FFLOS register entry). No build year, builder, staffing or demolition year found in any source read. The demolition is given only as 'the 1990s or 2000s', so no year-specific removal event is recorded. A search for a Forestry Commission link found nothing and none is assumed. The Wikipedia list of Louisiana fire lookout towers has no De Soto or Grove Hill entry. The nearby-sounding Dolet Hills Power Station (DeSoto Parish, closed end of 2021) is not linked to this site by any source and is not used. No access level recorded: the register does not state one.
